_comment: Year-by-year ramp grounded in the announced 3-stage roadmap (each facility ~1,000 tpa; Stage 1 Dec 2026, Stage 2 Jun 2027, Stage 3 H2 2027+). Battery-grade Li2CO3 prices (USD/t) re-anchored Jun 2026: current China spot ~$24-25k (off ~$28k May peak); Bernstein fcst $20k(2026)/$25k(2027). bear=downcycle/incentive 15k, base=mid-cycle 20k, bull=tight-market 25k. Converted via fx. discount_rate 0.10 assumes execution risk is captured via scenario probabilities (not double-counted in the rate). exit_ev_ebitda raised (8/12/15) to reflect that companies are still growing at exit + 220k blue-sky runway. opex_per_tonne_usd 7000 is based on the company's disclosed ~US$6.2k/t operating cost (press release, ~Jun 2026), rounded up; may exclude corporate SG&A/sustaining capex. capex (build cost) is still an ILLUSTRATIVE placeholder - NOT from filings. EBITDA = (price - opex) * tonnes, so margin rises with price. See assumptions.md and the Limitations section. net_debt = totalDebt 2,791,965 - totalCash 7,152,628.
